title: GrowthBook rail accent (v2)
description: A 4px gradient bar (navy → violet → white → blue → navy → green → mint) laid over a section's left hairline rail. It grows down as it enters the window, then sticks to the top while its section scrolls past.
notes: place inside a relative box whose left edge is the rail line
CSS only; the grow-in is off under reduced motion and in browsers without scroll timelines
